notes.title: Version 3.1.5 Update
notes.content: [h1][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h1][p]1. Fixed incorrect data-bar colors and layering when comparing data in the Interceptor.[/p][p]2. Fixed first-launch not starting in full screen despite the setting showing Full Screen.[/p][p]3. Fixed language changes not being saved.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b][/h1][p]1. Added 8 new languages.[/p][p]2. Unified text-box sizes across languages.[/p][p]3. Reduced full-screen bloom intensity.[/p][p]4. Enhanced outlines on certain icons and UI elements for better visibility.[/p]

notes.title: Version 3.1.4 Update: Fixed garbled display of Simplified Chinese
notes.content: [p]I sincerely apologize to all Simplified Chinese users — this fix may have come a bit late. I'm truly sorry! But today, I’ve finally fixed it. Thank you so much for your constant support and encouragement![/p][p]Next, I’ll remake the game as a thank-you to everyone who has supported me all along — that’s right, I’ve returned to indie game development![/p][p]I’ll continue fixing the major issues in the original game and remake it to bring it closer to my ideal vision. I’ll share the remake progress with the community. Please look forward to it! Thank you all![/p]

notes.content:

[/list]

notes.title: Special Thanks & Update (v 2.1.5)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Special Thanks
First of all, I will give my heartfelt thanks to these two connoisseurs: BrianRubin and geordietony
They gave me some very very useful advice for my game, thank you very much!
Here are their videos(For older version of my game):
BrianRubin: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XsORReULbMA
geordietony: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CDo_2FDN2go&feature=youtu.be
[*]BUG fixed
Fixed that sometimes can't collect materials.
Fixed some spelling mistakes on the title screen(So sorry for this).
[*]Improvements
After you docked into the hangar the game will be paused, so that you can select weapons and upgrade interceptor more easily.
The hangar now open and shut more quickly.
Damage report is available, it can be turned off on Option panel(Turned on by default).
Shoot down boss can get more material now.
[/list]

notes.title: Update (v 2.1.4)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]About the game background
Through several versions, you may noticed that the game background is colorful, but it's really not a voxel or pixel style like realy. So, I decided to use solid black to replace the colorful backgournd. If you have different opinion, please leave a message, I will appreciate that. Thank you^_^
[*]Bug fixed:
Sometimes can't dock into the hangar.
The textures of cannon and missile array sometimes turn to red.
[/list]
